explanation: This is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and fires only at GO, mostly when the agent picks a2: it climbs as unrewarded trials pile up (about 5-7 after one unrewarded trial, 8-10 after two or more in a row) and drops after a reward (about 7 right after one, falling to 1-4 after two or three rewarded trials in a row). It is highest late in the episode (trial 45 and later) and close to 0 early, and when the choice is a1 it stays at 0, or about 2-3 after a streak of unrewarded trials.
